messages:
alex: Quick follow-up from the GPU capacity postmortem yesterday — compiling action items. I'll list owners and proposed ETAs. Please reply with confirmations or push deadlines.

maria: Thanks. Can you paste the action list here so I can confirm ownership?

alex: Sure — high level: 
1) quota guardrail: enforce per-customer GPU limit (default 8 GPUs). owner: maria. ETA: 2026-03-31.
2) scheduler tuning: dynamic preemption window -> 15s, reduce scheduler churn. owner: taylor. ETA: 2026-03-25.
3) headroom dashboard + alerting (20% baseline). owner: devon. ETA: 2026-04-10.
4) autoscale canary + fallback policy (graceful degrade to cheaper model pool). owner: priya. ETA: 2026-04-02.
5) migration and rollback plan for quota enforcement. owner: maria + taylor. ETA: 2026-04-05.

taylor: ack. I'll run a controlled tuning on staging tomorrow and post results. Quick snippet of the scheduler knob I'm testing:```
# scheduler config
preemption_window_seconds: 15
max_concurrent_preemptions: 2
job_backoff_ms: 200
```

devon: ack — I'll wire the headroom dashboard. Plan: add a synthetic heavy job and a PD alert if headroom <18% for 5m. ETA aligns with 4/10.

maria: ack on quota enforcement. Need a migration window and a small migration script to reconcile active allocations — estimating PR by 2026-03-29, deploy 2026-04-05 unless we can hot-roll. Will also add logging for rejected quota requests.

priya: canary policy: will draft the policy doc and rollout steps by EOD Fri (2026-03-28). Will coordinate with SRE on traffic shaping for canary. Also proposing a short-lived 25% headroom allowance for model bursts during ramp.

oncall-bot: Incident tracker updated — created task list INC-4521 with items for quota/scheduler/headroom/canary (assigned).

alex: Two quick Qs: 1) minimum headroom percent — suggestion 20% baseline, 2) rollback plan for quota enforcement — we should ensure feature flag + quick revert lambda. Thoughts?

taylor: 20% baseline OK. For very bursty models let's allow an automatic temporary bump to 25% for up to 30m (ramp policy). I'll add test cases to staging runbook. I can own rollback test.

devon: PD alert: headroom <18% for 5m -> page SRE oncall. I'll also add a synthetic canary that fires every 30m to verify cluster health.

maria: Regarding rollback: will include flag and a one-click revert in the migration PR. PR ETA 2026-03-29. If anything goes sideways we can flip the flag and the revert lambda will reassign allocations.

priya: Also adding a post-deploy smoke: 1hr soak at 50% typical load then validate tail latency and error rates. If smoke fails -> automatic rollback.

alex: Great. Action owners confirmed. I'll update the postmortem ticket with owners/ETAs and link INC-4521. Can everyone drop short notes into the tracker when they start work?

maria: Will do. Dropping initial PR link when ready.

taylor: Added staging test plan to ops-runbook and will post results in the thread.

devon: Checklist added to dashboards repo.

alex: Let's regroup next Tue 10:00am PT for a quick 15m sync to validate staging results and cutover plan. I'll send calendar invite.

maria: Invite received :thumbsup:

taylor: Noted.

priya: Sounds good — thanks everyone.

alex: Closing this thread for now — will update INC-4521 and the postmortem doc with final owners/ETAs. Thanks all :pray:
